description: FIND-001 was only PARTIALLY closed. R1 (spec lines 14-18) was correctly rewritten to Wikipedia opensearch + HN Algolia, which now matches the implementation (research-product.mjs wikiSearch lines 15-23 + hnSearch lines 24-31). HOWEVER the authoritative spec still contains two stale, factually-wrong DuckDuckGo claims that contradict the corrected R1 and misdescribe the shipped code: (1) Goal line 8 states 'only free tools: DuckDuckGo HTML search + Jina Reader' — the impl uses NO DuckDuckGo; it uses Wikipedia + HN + Jina. (2) Purity boundary line 46 says 'the two fetch calls (DDG, Jina)' and line 47 says 'Pure: URL extraction from DDG HTML' — the impl makes THREE network endpoints per request (wikipedia.org, hn.algolia.com, r.jina.ai) and parses JSON (lines 19-22, 27-30), never DDG HTML. The spec is internally self-contradictory and asserts a data source that does not exist in the code, which is a spec-fidelity defect a Phase-6 convergence reader would be misled by.

creds) — only free tools: DuckDuckGo HTML search + Jina Reader (`r.jina.ai`).
